objective: Rehearsal on the tiny Muse test pack (random weights, test data): work every node of contract muse-2bit-rehearsal-r1 - build the stock engine and smoke it, requantize the tiny NVFP4 pack to the mixed 2-bit format, trace its routing into a seeded cache profile, and run the paired accuracy recipe to its first checkpoint. Before each node the scheduler agent finalizes its contract and binds its capsules; everything that executes runs through factory.capped_runner.

constraints.model_execution: Run every build, conversion, requantization and model load with factory.capped_runner (recipes build, convert, quantize, serve, accuracy). Each model load runs under the 96 GiB memory cap after the machine gate; if the gate is closed the run waits, and if it stays closed it fails MACHINE_BUSY - report it, do not work around it. Name the node on every start.
constraints.build_jobs: Builds use at most resources.build_jobs parallel jobs (the box is shared). Verifiers that compile take jobs of at most 4.
constraints.no_full_rehash: Do not ask a verifier to hash a whole pack (pass hash: false): reading 500 GB takes the disk for an hour. The checkpoint shard digests come from the hub's download metadata (operator input checkpoint_digests); pack headers are checked live.
constraints.agent_tools: Codex's own shell cannot start on this machine (its sandbox needs user namespaces the box does not allow). Read, edit and commit the owned checkout with factory.source_workbench (read, edit, write, localcommit); run everything else with capsule capabilities and factory.capped_runner. Do not retry the shell.
constraints.operator_records: The operator imports a few inputs as records of kind operator_input (the checkpoint digests from the hub download metadata, the earlier lab measurements) and records a host_reading at each run start (free disk, available memory, the cgroup now and the memory cap policy). Capped runs end with host records of kind capped_run. Find them with factory.evidence.query kinds ["operator_input", "host_reading", "capped_run"] and cite their ids.
constraints.workspace_files: Files you make (recipes, plans, profiles): give capsules an absolute path under resources.verifier_inputs.work_dir (FACTORY_HOME/agent-workspace/work, outside the checkout). Packs go under FACTORY_HOME/packs/<name>/: the convert and quantize recipes write there, so plan a recipe output as FACTORY_HOME/packs/<name>/<file>.gguf.

operator_labels.run: Rehearsal on test fixtures (tiny random-weight Muse pack); not a measurement of the model.

verifier_inputs.note: Rehearsal: the tiny test pack and its imatrix (made by the operator with llama-imatrix on the tiny pack) stand in for the real packs; checkpoint_index and imatrix are the real ones and are not used here.
